_comment: events.json — Featured events shown on the Home tab. Past events are auto-hidden by the app. Sorted by date ascending. Each event needs: id, title, date (ISO), location, blurb, image (either {uri: 'https://...'} or skip for default). Optional: endDate (multi-day), url (registration / details link).

events.title: The Real Saint Francis
